Sparen or Ausgeben? German A2 Money Verb Practice

Choose sparen for saving money and ausgeben for spending it in German. Practise separable forms with translated examples and explained A2 exercises.

A2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the difference

Geld sparen means to save money, by putting it aside or avoiding spending it. Geld ausgeben means to spend money. Ausgeben is separable: Ich gebe Geld aus. For an intended purchase, common patterns include für ein Fahrrad sparen and Geld für ein Fahrrad ausgeben.

Common mistake to avoid

Sparen can mean setting money aside or making a saving; it does not always mean depositing money in a bank account. Ausgeben describes spending in these examples.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Ich spare jeden Monat etwas für ein Fahrrad.I save a little each month for a bicycle.
Worked example 2Für den neuen Helm gebe ich dreißig Euro aus.I spend thirty euros on the new helmet.
Worked example 3Wir sparen das Geld für eine spätere Reise.We save the money for a later trip.
Worked example 4Sie gibt ungern Geld für unnötige Dinge aus.She dislikes spending money on unnecessary things.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose sparen for the specified saving or ausgeben for spending. Use the infinitive after the modal verb. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Das Geld möchte ich für später ___. (save)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: sparen

Sparen means keeping the money for later here.

Question 2. Für die Eintrittskarte muss ich zwölf Euro ___. (spend)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: ausgeben

Ausgeben describes the money spent on the ticket.

Question 3. Mit dem günstigeren Tarif können wir Geld ___. (save)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: sparen

Sparen can also mean reducing what needs to be spent.

Question 4. Für dieses Geschenk will ich nicht mehr als zwanzig Euro ___. (spend)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: ausgeben

Ausgeben names the spending action and follows will as an infinitive.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
